selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What words did the believers say when they saw Allah’s greatness and beauty shown in creation?
questions.answer: They said that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: What can we learn from the way they bowed and prostrated?
questions.answer: They were humble before Allah.

questions.question: What did they notice in the creatures around them?
questions.answer: They noticed wonderful and delicate art in them.

questions.question: What did they say to show that Allah gave blessings?
questions.answer: They said that Allah gave blessings.

questions.question: What words showed clear faith from their hearts?
questions.answer: They said that they truly believe.

questions.question: What words in the passage sum up that obedience?
questions.answer: We hear and we obey.

questions.question: What are the prescribed prayers called in the passage?
questions.answer: They are called a summary of worship.

questions.question: What did they complete by worshipping in this world?
questions.answer: They completed the duties and responsibilities of life.

questions.question: Because of what qualities did they become trusted on earth?
questions.answer: Because of belief, certainty, and the Trust.

questions.question: What final prayer is made at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: A prayer that Allah includes us among those blessed people.

questions.question: What did the believers say when they saw signs of Allah’s beauty, greatness, and perfection in the world?
questions.answer: They said that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: Did they bow with pride or with humility?
questions.answer: They bowed with humility.

questions.question: What words did they say to ask for help in the right way?
questions.answer: They said they seek help from Allah alone.

questions.question: What did they say to make their belief clear?
questions.answer: They said that they believe.

questions.question: What invitation did they give after seeing Allah’s signs?
questions.answer: They invited people to come, look, and hurry to prayer and success.

questions.question: What words showed this obedient attitude?
questions.answer: They said that they hear and obey.

questions.question: What did their prayers help gather together?
questions.answer: Their prayers gathered together the meaning of worship.

questions.question: What happened to them after they did these duties well?
questions.answer: They took on a beautiful form and rose to a high station.

questions.question: What trust and job were they given on earth?
questions.answer: They became trustworthy caretakers of the earth.

questions.question: What hopeful wish closes the passage?
questions.answer: A wish that Allah makes us among those blessed students.

questions.question: What was the believers’ first spoken response when they saw Allah’s greatness shown in creation?
questions.answer: They said that Allah is the Greatest.

questions.question: What made the believers turn to Allah in asking?
questions.answer: Their need and weakness made them turn to Him.

questions.question: When they saw the amazing things Allah made, what did they say about them?
questions.answer: They said Allah willed these wonders.

questions.question: Besides speaking, what other response did they have to creation?
questions.answer: They watched it, admired it, and praised its beauty.

title: Reality of Prayer Reverence Reliance Oneness and the End of the Believers
